record.bible_text: When a man<WH0376> hath taken<WH03947><WTH8799> a wife<WH0802>, and married<WH01166><WTH8804> her, and it come to pass that she find<WH04672><WTH8799> no favour<WH02580> in his eyes<WH05869>, because he hath found<WH04672><WTH8804> some<WH01697> uncleanness<WH06172> in her: then let him write<WH03789><WTH8804> her a bill<WH05612> of divorcement<WH03748>, and give<WH05414><WTH8804> <FI>it<Fi> in her hand<WH03027>, and send<WH07971><WTH8765> her out of his house<WH01004>. <RF>some...: Heb. matter of nakedness<Rf> <RF>divorcement: Heb. cutting off<Rf>
And when she is departed out<WH03318><WTH8804> of his house<WH01004>, she may go<WH01980><WTH8804> and be another<WH0312> man's<WH0376> <FI>wife<Fi> .

And <FI>if<Fi> the latter<WH0314> husband<WH0376> hate<WH08130><WTH8804> her, and write<WH03789><WTH8804> her a bill<WH05612> of divorcement<WH03748>, and giveth<WH05414><WTH8804> <FI>it<Fi> in her hand<WH03027>, and sendeth<WH07971><WTH8765> her out of his house<WH01004>; or if the latter<WH0314> husband<WH0376> die<WH04191><WTH8799>, which took<WH03947><WTH8804> her <FI>to be<Fi> his wife<WH0802>;

Her former<WH07223> husband<WH01167>, which sent her away<WH07971><WTH8765>, may<WH03201><WTH8799> not take<WH03947><WTH8800> her again<WH07725><WTH8800> to be his wife<WH0802>, after<WH0310> that she is defiled<WH02930><WTH8719>; for that <FI>is<Fi>  abomination<WH08441> before<WH06440> the LORD<WH03068>: and thou shalt not cause the land<WH0776> to sin<WH02398><WTH8686>, which the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> giveth<WH05414><WTH8802> thee <FI>for<Fi> an inheritance<WH05159>.<CM>

When a man<WH0376> hath taken<WH03947><WTH8799> a new<WH02319> wife<WH0802>, he shall not go out<WH03318><WTH8799> to war<WH06635>, neither shall he be charged<WH05674><WTH8799> with any business<WH01697>: <FI>but<Fi> he shall be free<WH05355> at home<WH01004> one<WH0259> year<WH08141>, and shall cheer up<WH08055><WTH8765> his wife<WH0802> which he hath taken<WH03947><WTH8804>. <RF>neither...: Heb. not any thing shall pass upon him<Rf>

No man shall take<WH02254><WH00> the nether<WH07347> or the upper millstone<WH07393> to pledge<WH02254><WTH8799>: for he taketh<WH02254><WH00> <FI>a man's<Fi> life<WH05315> to pledge<WH02254><WTH8802>.

If a man<WH0376> be found<WH04672><WTH8735> stealing<WH01589><WTH8802> any<WH05315> of his brethren<WH0251> of the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478>, and maketh merchandise<WH06014><WTH8694> of him, or selleth<WH04376><WTH8804> him; then that thief<WH01590> shall die<WH04191><WTH8804>; and thou shalt put<WH01197><WH00> evil<WH07451> away<WH01197><WTH8765> from among<WH07130> you.

Take heed<WH08104><WTH8734> in the plague<WH05061> of leprosy<WH06883>, that thou observe<WH08104><WTH8800> diligently<WH03966>, and do<WH06213><WTH8800> according to all that the priests<WH03548> the Levites<WH03881> shall teach<WH03384><WTH8686> you: as I commanded<WH06680><WTH8765> them, <FI>so<Fi> ye shall observe<WH08104><WTH8799> to do<WH06213><WTH8800>.

Remember<WH02142><WTH8800> what the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> did<WH06213><WTH8804> unto Miriam<WH04813> by the way<WH01870>, after that ye were come forth<WH03318><WTH8800> out of Egypt<WH04714>.

When thou dost lend<WH05383><WTH8686> thy brother<WH07453> any<WH03972> thing<WH04859>, thou shalt not go<WH0935><WTH8799> into his house<WH01004> to fetch<WH05670><WTH8800> his pledge<WH05667>. <RF>lend...: Heb. lend the loan of any thing to, etc<Rf>
Thou shalt stand<WH05975><WTH8799> abroad<WH02351>, and the man<WH0376> to whom thou dost lend<WH05383><WTH8802> shall bring out<WH03318><WTH8686> the pledge<WH05667> abroad<WH02351> unto thee.
And if the man<WH0376> <FI>be<Fi> poor<WH06041>, thou shalt not sleep<WH07901><WTH8799> with his pledge<WH05667>:

In any case<WH07725><WTH8687> thou shalt deliver<WH07725><WH00> him the pledge<WH05667> again<WH07725><WTH8686> when the sun<WH08121> goeth down<WH0935><WTH8800>, that he may sleep<WH07901><WTH8804> in his own raiment<WH08008>, and bless<WH01288><WTH8765> thee: and it shall be righteousness<WH06666> unto thee before<WH06440> the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430>.<CM>

Thou shalt not oppress<WH06231><WTH8799> an hired servant<WH07916> <FI>that is<Fi> poor<WH06041> and needy<WH034>, <FI>whether he be<Fi> of thy brethren<WH0251>, or of thy strangers<WH01616> that <FI>are<Fi> in thy land<WH0776> within thy gates<WH08179>:

At his day<WH03117> thou shalt give<WH05414><WTH8799> <FI>him<Fi> his hire<WH07939>, neither shall the sun<WH08121> go down<WH0935><WTH8799> upon it; for he <FI>is<Fi> poor<WH06041>, and setteth<WH05375><WTH8802> his heart<WH05315> upon it: lest he cry<WH07121><WTH8799> against thee unto the LORD<WH03068>, and it be sin<WH02399> unto thee. <RF>setteth...: Heb. lifteth his soul unto it<Rf>

The fathers<WH01> shall not be put to death<WH04191><WTH8714> for the children<WH01121>, neither shall the children<WH01121> be put to death<WH04191><WTH8714> for the fathers<WH01>: every man<WH0376> shall be put to death<WH04191><WTH8714> for his own sin<WH02399>.

Thou shalt not pervert<WH05186><WTH8686> the judgment<WH04941> of the stranger<WH01616>, <FI>nor<Fi> of the fatherless<WH03490>; nor take<WH02254><WH00> a widow's<WH0490> raiment<WH0899> to pledge<WH02254><WTH8799>:

But thou shalt remember<WH02142><WTH8804> that thou wast a bondman<WH05650> in Egypt<WH04714>, and the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> redeemed<WH06299><WTH8799> thee thence: therefore I command<WH06680><WTH8764> thee to do<WH06213><WTH8800> this thing<WH01697>.

When thou cuttest down<WH07114><WTH8799> thine harvest<WH07105> in thy field<WH07704>, and hast forgot<WH07911><WTH8804> a sheaf<WH06016> in the field<WH07704>, thou shalt not go again<WH07725><WTH8799> to fetch<WH03947><WTH8800> it: it shall be for the stranger<WH01616>, for the fatherless<WH03490>, and for the widow<WH0490>: that the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> may bless<WH01288><WTH8762> thee in all the work<WH04639> of thine hands<WH03027>.

When thou beatest<WH02251><WTH8799> thine olive tree<WH02132>, thou shalt not go over the boughs<WH06286><WTH8762> again<WH0310>: it shall be for the stranger<WH01616>, for the fatherless<WH03490>, and for the widow<WH0490>. <RF>go...: Heb. bough it after thee<Rf>

When thou gatherest<WH01219><WTH8799> the grapes of thy vineyard<WH03754>, thou shalt not glean<WH05953><WTH8779> <FI>it<Fi> afterward<WH0310>: it shall be for the stranger<WH01616>, for the fatherless<WH03490>, and for the widow<WH0490>. <RF>afterward: Heb. after thee<Rf>

And thou shalt remember<WH02142><WTH8804> that thou wast a bondman<WH05650> in the land<WH0776> of Egypt<WH04714>: therefore I command<WH06680><WTH8764> thee to do<WH06213><WTH8800> this thing<WH01697>.<CM>
